Reports are identified by an ACE ID (project, year, and report number, e.g. `ACE2026001`) and are available online and as a PDF. Corrections and author responses are incorporated into new versions and recorded in each report's version history. See [About](about.qmd) for the evidence standard behind every finding and [Disclaimers](disclaimers.qmd) for the editorial and correspondence policy.
